title: The building knowledge base: every rule, pitfall, finding and precedent proposed with its evidence, accepted only by a person
request: Collect the knowledge of building models correctly.
plan: Propose KnowledgeItems from the evidence index's rules, pitfalls, findings and leakage precedents.
A person's yes kept in docs/knowledge/building/.

decisions.why: The owner's rule for the knowledge base.

decisions.decision: A rule is measured_here only with evidence beyond the rules file.
decisions.why: A rule without a campaign is a hypothesis.

change: dclab_rnd/store/service.py knowledge() and accept(); python -m dclab_rnd.store knowledge|know-accept.

findings.defect: Findings citing only generated packs were measured_here; an accepted item was never flagged; CLAUDE.md's rules were missing.
findings.scenario: Items promoted past hypothesis without a campaign.
findings.cause: Every non-rule type counted as measured.
findings.fix: measured_here only with a citation under evidence/campaigns/; an accepted item compared with its source and flagged; CLAUDE.md rules added.

measurements.name: knowledge items proposed
measurements.gate: every rule, pitfall, finding and precedent proposed; none accepted by code
measurements.result: items proposed from the evidence index and CLAUDE.md; 0 accepted
limits: the count changes as the evidence index grows

outcome: 46 items proposed (45 measured here, 1 hypothesis), none accepted.
lessons: Write fixtures from the code that writes the records (a stage record copied from the engine), never from memory: invented shapes made every test pass while every real build was judged wrong.
risks: Stage inference by keywords for records without a category is rough.
